title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
summary: Join CAXiE's engineering team to build and maintain web applications, internal tools, and client-facing digital products. You'll work across the stack — React/Next.js on the frontend, Node.js or Python on the backend — with a security-first mindset baked in from the start.
requirements: 3+ years of professional full-stack development experience
Proficiency in React / Next.js and Node.js or Python
Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strong understanding of web security fundamentals
Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
niceToHave: Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or Firebase
Background in cybersecurity or secure SDLC practices

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: CAXiE is growing its cybersecurity practice and needs a hands-on analyst to support client security assessments, vulnerability scanning, and ongoing monitoring engagements. You'll work directly with Xavier on some of our most critical client accounts.
requirements: 2+ years in a cybersecurity role (analyst, SOC, or penetration testing)
Solid understanding of network security, firewalls, and endpoint protection
Experience with vulnerability scanning tools (Nessus, OpenVAS, or equivalent)
Knowledge of frameworks: NIST CSF, ISO 27001 principles
Strong written communication — you'll be producing client-facing reports
niceToHave: CompTIA Security+, CEH, or OSCP certification
Understanding of Nigerian data protection regulations (NDPR)
